versos.e: “My kingdom is not of this world,” Joh 18:36
.To a man who sowed good seed Mt 13:24-30,38-43; Mr 4:26-29
.To a granule of mustard seed Mt 13:31,32; Mr 4:30,31; Lu 13:18,19
Children of the Mt 18:3; 19:14; Mr 10:14; Lu 18:16
.To a king who called his servants for a reckoning (an audit) Mt 18:23-35
Rich people cannot enter Mt 19:23,24; Mr 10:23-25; Lu 18:24,25,29,30
.To a king who made a marriage feast for his son Mt 22:2-14; Lu 14:16-24
.To a man, traveling into a far country, who called his servants, and delivered to them his goods Mt 25:14-30; Lu 19:12-27
Does not consist of meat and drink Ro 14:17
